title: My daily routine
objectives: describe morning and evening daily routine actions
tell time with o'clock and half past

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for My daily routine.
Welcome to today's lesson: My daily routine! Today we will practice how to describe morning and evening daily routine actions.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for My daily routine:
describe morning and evening daily routine actions; tell time with o'clock and half past

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: wake, get, wash, brush, shower, bed

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What time does the speaker go to work?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Every morning I wake up early. I shower, brush my teeth, and go to work at half past eight.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
I wake up at seven o'clock. I wash my face and shower. Then I go to work at eight o'clock.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Walk your partner through your morning routine stating exact times.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: describe morning and evening daily routine actions, tell time with o'clock and half past.
